div.div:
Buys you: validate or transform as they type, disable Submit live, force uppercase, drive the field from elsewhere.
Costs you: a render per character. Rarely matters — until the form is large or each render is expensive.

div.div:
Buys you: zero renders while typing, and less code for a plain form.
Costs you: the value is only readable on demand, so live validation and cross-field rules get awkward.
